title: Positive expectations predict improved mental-health outcomes linked to ...
abstract: The study investigated the effects of psychedelic microdosing on mental health and well-being. It found that participants reported increased psychological well-being, emotional stability, and reductions in anxiety and depressive symptoms after four weeks of microdosing. However, a key finding was that positive expectations about microdosing at the beginning of the study predicted these subsequent improvements, suggesting a significant placebo effect. The study highlights the role of positive expectancy in psychedelic microdosing outcomes and cautions against overstating its therapeutic value.
